person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages use unframed close-third narration of Kate and another focal character, while most other quotes are maxims, dialogue, clipped fragments, or isolated third-person references. The authorized opening independently shows sustained close-third narration, and whole-book structural evidence says the novel shifts among several family members in third person. Tiger's first-person letters are embedded documents within that third-person framework, so they do not make the base narration alternating. Interior passages from multiple parts corroborate that the close-third pattern continues beyond the opening; no credible source indicates sustained first- or second-person base sections.
